When Kodak Black was spotted sitting in the middle of the road eating chicken 🍗

Kodak Black, born Bill K. Kapri (originally Dieuson Octave), is an American rapper who emerged as a central figure in the modern Southern hip-hop scene. Raised in Pompano Beach, Florida, he gained widespread national attention in the mid-2010s with breakout tracks like “No Flockin” and “Tunnel Vision.” His music is defined by a distinctively raw delivery, melodic flows, and deeply personal storytelling that frequently explores his upbringing, street life, and struggles with fame.

Throughout his career, Kodak Black has achieved significant commercial success, earn-ing multiple platinum certifications and collaborating with some of the biggest names in the music industry, including Kendrick Lamar, Travis Scott, and Drake. Beyond his chart-topping hits, his career has also been heavily marked by frequent legal troubles and controversies, making him one of the most compelling yet polarizing figures in contemporary rap.
